Book 18 (微子) — keys the --check reports as lacking a glossary entry, with the reading used and where.
(unit numbers are 0-based UNITS indexes; passage in brackets)

## Bound compounds (new keys)
微子    wēi zǐ    the Viscount of Wei: elder half-brother of Zhou 紂, last king of the Shang (Zhu Xi 微箕二國名子爵也微子紂庶兄)  — u0 (18.1)
箕子    jī zǐ     the Viscount of Ji: an uncle of Zhou, imprisoned and made a slave (Zhu Xi 箕子比干紂諸父)  — u0 (18.1)
比干    bǐ gān    Bi Gan: an uncle of Zhou, killed for remonstrating  — u0 (18.1)
士師    shì shī   officer of justice, over trials and prisons (Zhu Xi 士師獄官; Kong Anguo 典獄之官)  — u2 (18.2)
季桓子  jì huán zǐ  Ji Huanzi: Jisun Si 季孫斯, head of the Ji house, grandee of Lu (Zhu Xi 季桓子魯大夫名斯)  — u4 (18.4)
接輿    jiē yú    Jieyu: a man of Chu who feigned madness to keep away from the world (Zhu Xi 接輿楚人佯狂辟世)  — u5 (18.5)
長沮    cháng jǔ  Changju: a recluse (Zhu Xi 沮七余反, a level-tone spelling, modern qū; modern editions jǔ)  — u7, u8 (18.6)
桀溺    jié nì    Jieni: a recluse (Zhu Xi 溺乃歴反)  — u7, u9 ×2 (18.6)
孔丘    kǒng qiū  Kong Qiu: Confucius's surname and personal name  — u8 ×2, u9 (18.6)
滔滔    tāo tāo   surging on and away, flowing off and never coming back (Zhu Xi 滔土刀反…滔滔流而不反之意; Kong Anguo 周流之貌)  — u9 (18.6)
憮然    wǔ rán    dismayed, rueful (Zhu Xi 憮音武…憮然猶悵然惜其不喻己意也)  — u10 (18.6)
丈人    zhàng rén an elder, an old man (Bao Xian 丈人老者也; Zhu Xi 丈人亦隠者)  — u11 ×2 (18.7)
逸民    yì mín    men left out (of office): men of worth without rank (Zhu Xi 逸遺逸民者無位之稱; He Yan 節行超逸者)  — u16 (18.8)
虞仲    yú zhòng  Yu Zhong: by Zhu Xi Zhongyong 仲雍, brother of Taibo (虞仲即仲雍)  — u16, u19 (18.8)
夷逸    yí yì     Yi Yi: one of the men left out (Zhu Xi 不見經傳)  — u16, u19 (18.8)
朱張    zhū zhāng Zhu Zhang: one of the men left out (Zhu Xi 不見經傳)  — u16 (18.8)
少連    shào lián Shao Lian: a man of the Eastern Yi, good at mourning (Zhu Xi 少去聲…少連東夷人)  — u16, u18 (18.8)
亞飯    yà fàn    (the musician of) the second meal (Zhu Xi 以樂侑食之官; Kong Anguo 亞次也)  — u22 (18.9)
三飯    sān fàn   (the musician of) the third meal (Bao Xian: 樂章名, a piece of music)  — u22 (18.9)
四飯    sì fàn    (the musician of) the fourth meal  — u22 (18.9)
方叔    fāng shū  Fang Shu: the drummer of Lu (Zhu Xi 方叔名)  — u23 (18.9)
少師    shào shī  the Assistant Music-Master (Zhu Xi 少去聲…少師樂官之佐)  — u25 (18.9)
魯公    lǔ gōng   the Duke of Lu: Bo Qin 伯禽, the Duke of Zhou's son (Zhu Xi 魯公周公子伯禽也)  — u26 (18.10)
伯達    bó dá     Bo Da, eldest of the eight officers of Zhou  — u27 (18.11)
伯适    bó kuò    Bo Kuo  — u27 (18.11)
仲突    zhòng tū  Zhong Tu  — u27 (18.11)
仲忍    zhòng rěn Zhong Ren (Ruan and He Yan 仲忽)  — u27 (18.11)
叔夜    shū yè    Shu Ye  — u27 (18.11)
叔夏    shū xià   Shu Xia  — u27 (18.11)
季隨    jì suí    Ji Sui  — u27 (18.11)
季騧    jì guā    Ji Gua (Zhu Xi 騧烏瓜反, pointing to wā)  — u27 (18.11)

## Single characters (new keys)
箕  jī     Ji, a state (in 箕子); a winnowing basket  — u0 (18.1)
奴  nú     a slave (為之奴)  — u0 (18.1)
黜  chù    to put out of office, to dismiss (Zhu Xi 黜退也)  — u2 ×2 (18.2)
楚  chǔ    Chu, the great state of the south  — u5, u22 (18.5, 18.9)
接  jiē    to meet, to receive (in 接輿)  — u5 (18.5)
沮  jǔ     to check, to stop (in 長沮; Zhu Xi 七余反)  — u7, u8 (18.6)
桀  jié    Jie (in 桀溺); outstanding, also the name of the last Xia king  — u7, u9 (18.6)
溺  nì     to sink, to soak, to drown (in 桀溺; Zhu Xi 乃歴反)  — u7, u9 (18.6)
耦  ǒu     in a pair, two ploughing side by side (Zhu Xi 耦並耕也; Zheng Xuan 二耜為耦)  — u7 (18.6)
津  jīn    a ford, a crossing place (Zhu Xi, Zheng Xuan 濟渡處)  — u7, u8 (18.6)
滔  tāo    to surge, to overflow (in 滔滔; Zhu Xi 土刀反)  — u9 (18.6)
耰  yōu    to cover the seed with earth (Zhu Xi 音憂…耰覆種也; Zheng Xuan the same)  — u9 (18.6)
輟  chuò   to stop, to break off (Zheng Xuan 輟止也)  — u9 (18.6)
憮  wǔ     dismayed, disappointed (in 憮然; Zhu Xi 憮音武)  — u10 (18.6)
丈  zhàng  a measure of ten feet; an elder (in 丈人)  — u11 (18.7)
蓧  diào   a bamboo basket or vessel (Zhu Xi 徒弔反…蓧竹器; Bao Xian 竹器名)  — u11 (18.7)
體  tǐ     a limb; the body (四體 'the four limbs')  — u11 (18.7)
勤  qín    to toil, to labour  — u11 (18.7)
植  zhí    to set upright, to stand (a staff) in the ground (Zhu Xi 植音值…植立之也; Kong Anguo 植倚也 'to lean')  — u11 (18.7)
芸  yún    to weed (Zhu Xi 芸去草也; Kong Anguo 除草曰芸)  — u11 (18.7)
拱  gǒng   to join the hands before the chest in respect  — u12 (18.7)
黍  shǔ    millet (glutinous millet)  — u13 (18.7)
倫  lún    order, the proper order; the bonds between people (Zhu Xi 倫序也 / 倫義理之次第也; Bao Xian 倫道也理也)  — u15 (18.7), u18 (18.8)
逸  yì     left out, passed over (Zhu Xi 逸遺逸); in 逸民, 夷逸  — u16, u19 (18.8)
連  lián   to join (in 少連)  — u16, u18 (18.8)
亞  yà     second, next (Kong Anguo 亞次也; in 亞飯)  — u22 (18.9)
繚  liǎo   Liao, a musician's name (Zhu Xi 繚音了)  — u22 (18.9)
缺  quē    Que, a musician's name; lacking, a gap  — u22 (18.9)
秦  qín    Qin, a state in the west  — u22 (18.9)
播  bō     to shake, to twirl (Zhu Xi 播搖也; Kong Anguo 播猶搖也)  — u24 (18.9)
鼗  táo    a hand-drum twirled by its handle so that two side-ears strike it (Zhu Xi 徒刀反…鼗小鼓兩旁有耳)  — u24 (18.9)
漢  hàn    the Han River; its country (Zhu Xi 漢漢中)  — u24 (18.9)
襄  xiāng  Xiang, the chime-stone player (Zhu Xi 襄即孔子所従學琴者)  — u25 (18.9)

隨  suí    to follow (in 季隨)  — u27 (18.11)
騧  guā    a yellow horse with a black muzzle (in 季騧; Zhu Xi 烏瓜反 = wā)  — u27 (18.11)

狂   'a madman; one who feigns madness' (楚狂接輿, u5 18.5; Zhu Xi 佯狂辟世)
過   'to pass by, to go past' (歌而過孔子, u5 18.5; 孔子過之, u7 18.6)
下   'to get down (from a carriage)' (孔子下, u6 18.5; Zhu Xi 孔子下車)
而   'you' (= 汝; 且而與其…, u9 18.6; Zhu Xi 而汝也)
以   'with' (= 與; 誰以易之, u9 18.6; Zhu Xi 以猶與也)
易   yì 'to change, to transform (the world)' (誰以易之, u9; 丘不與易也, u10 18.6; Zhu Xi 欲以道易之)
後   hòu 'to fall behind, to lag' (子路從而後, u11 18.7)
夫子 'my master / your master': any teacher, in a disciple's or stranger's mouth (子見夫子乎, 孰為夫子, u11 18.7)
分   fēn 'to tell apart, to distinguish' (五榖不分, u11 18.7; Zhu Xi 分辨也); Bao Xian 'to plant out' (分殖)
止   'to detain, to keep (a guest) from leaving' (止子路宿, u13 18.7)
見   xiàn 'to present (someone) to, to bring before' — transitive (見其二子焉, u13 18.7; Zhu Xi 見賢遍反)
明   'next' in 明日 'the next day' (u14 18.7)
節   'the proper order, the due measure (between elder and younger)' (長幼之節, u15 18.7)

夷   Yi, part of a personal name (夷逸, u16, u19 18.8)
虞   Yu, in the name 虞仲 (u16, u19 18.8)
朱   Zhu, a surname (朱張, u16 18.8)
降   jiàng 'to lower (one's aims)', transitive (不降其志, u17; 降志, u18 18.8)
廢   'to set oneself aside, to withdraw from affairs' (廢中權, u19 18.8; Zhu Xi 放言自廢; Ma Rong 自廢棄以免患)
干   Gan, a musician's name (亞飯干, u22 18.9)
鼓   'the drummer, one who beats the drum' (鼓方叔, u23 18.9; Zhu Xi 鼓擊鼓者)
武   Wu, a musician's name (播鼗武, u24 18.9)
陽   Yang, a musician's name (少師陽, u25 18.9)
入   'to go in to (a region), to go to live in' (入於河/漢/海, u23–25 18.9; Bao Xian 入謂居其河內也)
河   河内, the land within the River (u23 18.9; Zhu Xi 河河内)
施   shī read as 弛 'to neglect, to cast off' (君子不施其親, u26 18.10; Zhu Xi 施陸氏本作弛…弛遺棄也); Kong Anguo 施易也 'to put (others) in place of'
故   'a cause, a grave wrong' in 大故 (無大故, u26 18.10; Zhu Xi and Kong Anguo 大故謂惡逆)
